test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Ministry of Education (MoE) in February 2022 approved a new scheme ______ for the next five years to cover all the aspects of adult education to align with new the National Education Policy (NEP).
solution:
The correct answer is __**New India Literacy Programme.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **New India Literacy Programme** aligns with th**e National Education Policy** and covers all aspects of adult education for the** next five years.**
 
• The New India Literacy Programme aims to achieve **100% literacy rate** in India by providing functional literacy and basic education to all adults who lack these skills.
 
• Financially, it will cost Rs. **10,379.90 crore **and be implemented between** FYs 2022–2023 **and** 2026–2027**, following the National Education Policy (NEP)** 2020** recommendations.

 All nonliterates who are at least **15 years old** are the target audience for the program. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Open Education Programme** is a **distance learning program** that offers open access to education for anyone, anywhere, at any time, but it may not cover all aspects of **adult education **as required by the **NEP.**
 
• **ASHA (Accredited Social Health Activist) **is a** community health worker program** that aims to improve health outcomes in rural areas, and it is not related to adult education.
